hero.title: Marienbad: Healing Springs, Serenity and a Stay That Restores Body and Mind
hero.subtitle: Whether you seek wellness, medical treatments, architecture or a weekend in nature — find everything you need in one place.

emotionalBlock.headline: You come for the treatments. You return for the calm.
emotionalBlock.text: Marienbad is more than a spa town — it is days of slowing down, breathing deeply and finding your balance again.
emotionalBlock.proof: UNESCO World Heritage · 40+ Mineral Springs · 4 Natural Healing Elements · 4.8/5 Google

healingElements.title: Four Natural Healing Resources
healingElements.description: One of the rare spa destinations that unites all four elements of natural healing.

items.name: Water
items.description: Over 40 mineral springs with unique compositions — from drinking cures to therapeutic healing baths.

items.name: Earth
items.description: Natural peat peloids with powerful anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving properties.

items.name: Gas
items.description: 99.7% pure CO₂ — "Maria's Gas" — traditionally used to support peripheral circulation.

items.name: Climate
items.description: Certified healing climate at 630m elevation — pure forest air enriched with natural aerosols. Since 2023, Mariánské Lázně has held the official designation of a Climatic Spa.

discover.title: Discover the Town
discover.description: Mariánské Lázně — the world-famous Marienbad — has enchanted visitors from around the globe for over 200 years with its healing springs, grand architecture, and breathtaking natural beauty.

hotels.title: Where to Stay in Marienbad
hotels.description: From historic 5-star spa hotels to three-star hotels.

items.name: Ensana Nové Lázně
items.description: A historic 5-star gem featuring an original Roman Bath — the flagship of the Ensana Spa Hotels collection.

items.name: Ensana Centrální Lázně
items.description: Steps from the Colonnade — traditional spa treatments in a prime central location with modern therapy rooms.

items.name: Ensana Hvězda
items.description: Empire-style spa hotel on Goethe Square — the largest Ensana hotel, with its own balneology centre.

items.name: Ensana Pacifik
items.description: Grand hotel on the main promenade with views over Skalník Park and full spa care.

items.name: Ensana Butterfly
items.description: Modern spa hotel on the main promenade, steps from the colonnade.

items.name: Ensana Vltava
items.description: A comfortable spa hotel with full treatment at a friendly price.

items.name: Ensana Svoboda
items.description: Traditional spa hotel in the centre, close to the springs.

people.title: Stories the Waters Tell
people.description: Real stories from real people — spa guests, locals, and doctors share why Marienbad is a place like no other.

stories.quote: „Die Kreuzquelle ist wie ein alter Freund — jedes Jahr bringe ich ihm einen Besuch.“

stories.quote: "I came for the treatment, but I stayed for the peace."

stories.quote: «Мариенбад — это не просто курорт. Это место, где душа отдыхает.»

seasonal.title: The Springs Await — Your Cure in Marienbad
seasonal.description: Every season, Marienbad offers something special: the Skalníkovy Gardens delight with ever-changing colours, the Singing Fountain performs its legendary water shows, and the gentle mountain air at 630 metres becomes nature's own remedy for the respiratory system.
